meta.title: eRFX Auction stage, one clause Required: the vendor accepts only the optional clause
gaps: Assert that the required clause is visually highlighted as opposed to merely being present and blocking submission.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that the required clause is visually highlighted as opposed to merely being present and blocking submission.

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow for the Auction-stage event.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Add the item to be quoted.
Complete the Auction pricing sheet so the event can be published.

args.goal: On the Auction stage, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, click Done, and stop with the configured terms visible or saved

steps.note: Configure the required and optional clauses because no dedicated catalog step edits stage terms and conditions.
Invite one QA vendor to act as Vendor A.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Move to the separate supplier portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's Auction pricing round as the invited vendor.
Confirm the required clause is visible in the vendor's Terms & Conditions block.
Accept only the optional clause, leaving the required clause unaccepted.
Attempt to submit a quote of 100 and require evidence that submission is blocked while the required clause is not accepted.
Accept the required clause after the blocked submission.
Submit the 100 quote after all required terms have been accepted.
Assert that the vendor bid was successfully submitted.
